PRIOR_ANCHOR_ALTERNATIVE.rule: If prior equals the D0 top party, replace it with the D0 runner-up; otherwise replace it with the D0 top party. ABSTAIN is treated like any non-top prior.
PRIOR_ANCHOR_ALTERNATIVE.interpretation: Tests sensitivity to the explicit behavioural anchor; not a realistic historical claim.

GOVERNMENT_OUTLOOK_REVERSE.target: voter latent government-performance and democracy-satisfaction means
GOVERNMENT_OUTLOOK_REVERSE.rule: If the D0 top party is in the incumbent coalition, subtract the registered shifts; otherwise add them. Clamp all modified means to [0,1].

RUNNER_LOCAL_STRENGTH.rule: Set candidate rank=1, FORMER_MP=true, LOCAL_EXECUTIVE_OFFICE=true and PROVINCIAL_OR_REGIONAL_OFFICE=true as VERIFIED/non-conflicted; clear verified negative withdrawal/sanction/incapacity flags to false.
RUNNER_LOCAL_STRENGTH.interpretation: Tests whether a materially stronger local offer can close the D0 margin.

TOP_RUNNER_PROGRAM_SWAP.rule: Swap the complete anonymous program-priority maps while preserving party IDs and government status.
TOP_RUNNER_PROGRAM_SWAP.interpretation: Tests whether relative program fit, rather than identity or incumbency, drives the D0 ordering.

NONINFORMATIVE_METADATA_PLACEBO.rule: Add an explicitly non-political random-looking but deterministic placebo nonce. Do not alter any voter, party or election field.
NONINFORMATIVE_METADATA_PLACEBO.interpretation: A scientifically stable judge should not materially change its decision.
